title: 第一章 开局签到极道帝兵 混沌钟第二章 来一人一包
slug: 开局成为首座签到极道帝兵
lines: ：至于多出来的一把。
以及一些黄金器级别的弓箭手装备，以及其他不全的几件箭甲龙装备，自然都交给狂人，放到行会里处理给那些弓箭手职业地弟兄。
突然那只被麻痹了的魔蜘蛛从桌子上跳了起来，一个狼卫拔出了随身的匕首就把它给扫到了地面上去，然后那魔蜘蛛落到了地上以后顿时变成了直径近三米的巨型蜘蛛，狰狞的模样非常骇人。
木黎香应了一声，便化成了貂的模样，从窗户的缝隙窜了出去了。
瞬间屋内变得极为安静，江岚没有动，那人也没有动，一个在光天化日之下，一个则隐藏在空气中。
堕落的神同时打量着我们这支队伍，扫过血杀天下等人的目光显得十分不屑，直到看到我们烈焰的人，在我们身上顿了顿，这才回望狂人。
不过这个显然是‘肉搏型’的身高过七米手提一把一米粗三米多长的黄金巨锤走过来的时候仿佛要深陷到地里；全身更如金属雕塑般显然是物攻物防骇人的家伙。
奉向梦唤了一声，那一脸的委屈看上去就像是刚才被奉长赢百般羞辱了一样。
萨莫拉诺和自己一样，是个不得不重点盯防的杀手——两人的性格都像是眼镜蛇，盘在那里等待最好的机会，然后一击致命。
梦魇骑士甚至连轻微的停顿都没出现，无动于衷的继续攻击玄铁护甲，一副要把麦斯吃死在里面的架势。
只是这名字犯了隔壁穆山城新城主洛暮秋的名讳，这才将暮字给去掉，变成了不伦不类的逐城。
木奇朗尴尬的笑了笑，显然没有想到杨帆竟然如此猖狂。
在拿到那些名单的时候，就连狼三都说了有些棘手。
当然期间秦羽肯定还是和苏叔解释了一下他没有责怪对方的那件事情啦，不过貌似苏叔看起来也很释然，也没多说什么。
只是走的时候又再一次和秦羽说了让他星期六的时候来家里吃饭。
看着全场无数道目光朝着自己看来，震惊，同情，戏谑各种眼神都有，也不知道是谁起哄叫了一声“答应他。”
全场所有人就都跟着一起高喊起来了。
“那你又为什么要告诉我，不怕我阻止你么？”
苏辰眯着眼睛问道。
看着田野肩上的血洞慢慢愈合，人罗刹的脸上满是疑惑，但心中却是无尽的贪婪。
看着秋上佳音羞涩的面容，田野并没有想这么多，他无奈的看着佳音的背影。
再往下几百米就是公路，越过公路，外面就是街区，虽然山庄所在的位置不是闹市区，可周围也是人烟密集，这家伙要是跑出去，他都不敢想象会闹出什么样的后果。
“段叔，我都说了千万别再公子公子的叫我，你还是直接叫我名字吧。”
content_en:
: As for the extra handful.
As well as some gold-level archer equipment, as well as a few other incomplete pieces of armored dragon equipment, they were naturally handed over to the madman and placed in the guild for disposal by the brothers in the archer profession.
Suddenly the paralyzed demon spider jumped up from the table. A wolf guard pulled out his dagger and swept it to the ground. Then when the demon spider fell to the ground, it immediately turned into a giant spider with a diameter of nearly three meters. Its ferocious appearance was very scary.
"Okay."
Mu Lixiang responded, turned into a mink, and ran out through the gap in the window.
In an instant, the room became extremely quiet. Jiang Lan did not move, and neither did the man. One was in broad daylight, and the other was hidden in the air.
The fallen god looked at our team at the same time, looking at Xue Sha Tianxia and others with great disdain. It wasn't until the man who saw our Lieyan paused on us that he looked back at the madman.
However, this man who was clearly a 'hand-to-hand combat type' who was over seven meters tall and carried a golden hammer that was one meter thick and over three meters long seemed to be sinking into the ground when he walked over. His whole body was like a metal sculpture, and he was clearly a terrifying guy in terms of physical attack and defense.
"Dad..."
Feng Xiang called out to Meng, and the aggrieved look on his face looked like he had been humiliated in every possible way by Feng Changying just now.
Zamorano, like himself, is a killer who has to focus on keeping an eye on him - both of them have personalities like cobras, coiling around waiting for the best opportunity, and then delivering a fatal blow.
The Nightmare Knight didn't even pause for a moment, and continued to attack the black iron armor indifferently, as if he wanted to eat Max to death inside.
It's just that this name offended the name of Luo Muqiu, the new lord of Mushan City next door, so the word "mu" was removed and it became a nondescript Zhucheng.
Mu Qilang smiled awkwardly, obviously not expecting Yang Fan to be so rampant.
When getting those lists, even Wolf Three said it was a little tricky.
Of course, Qin Yu must have explained to Uncle Su that he didn't blame the other party, but it seemed that Uncle Su was relieved and didn't say much.
When he left, he told Qin Yu again that he should come to his house for dinner on Saturday.
He saw countless eyes in the audience looking at him, ranging from shock to sympathy to joking, and he didn't know who yelled "Promise him."
Everyone in the audience shouted together.
"Then why did you tell me? Aren't you afraid that I would stop you?"
Su Chen asked with narrowed eyes.
Seeing the bloody hole on Tian Ye's shoulder slowly healing, the human Rakshasa's face was full of doubts, but his heart was full of endless greed.
Looking at Qiu Shangjiayin's shy face, Tian Ye didn't think so much. He looked helplessly at Jiayin's back.
A few hundred meters further down is the highway, and beyond the highway is the neighborhood. Although the location of the villa is not in a downtown area, the surrounding area is densely populated. If this guy runs out, he can't imagine what the consequences will be.
"Uncle Duan, I told you never to call me son-in-law again. You should just call me by my name."
